name: View your own profile (no Follow or send-money buttons)
description: Opens the app's side menu and taps into your own profile page. Because it is your own profile, the Follow and send-money buttons are correctly absent, and the page loads its stats without crashing even for a brand-new user.
details: Opening the drawer and tapping the profile name navigates to the viewer's OWN social profile — proven by the new user-profile:own probe — where the Follow and Send-Money affordances are correctly ABSENT (they only show on other people's profiles); the profile renders its stats without crash for a brand-new user with no follows. Back to the wallet
